title: work.read@1
description: A work source's run or "Fix <id>" read (#66): the items it took in, the tasks it opened and the read position after them, in one append, so a stop between them loses nothing and takes nothing twice.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

source.description: The work source's handle: the one you added, which is also its schedule's name.

position.description: Where the next run reads from: a time 5 s before the newest item read, or null before the first run.

state.x-opaque: the run's opened tasks, taken events, skipped, refused, dropped and failing items, as the hub's work sources keep them
